objective: End-to-end system evolution, automated synthesis, deterministic reconciliation, and market-ready deployment

invariants.orphaned_service_prevention: Every service must resolve owner, lineage, runtime, rollback, proof and public projection before promotion

system_streams.discovery: inventory -> classify -> dependency graph -> capability match
system_streams.synthesis: validated pattern -> module template -> generated implementation -> static validation
system_streams.reconciliation: source state -> observed state -> delta -> repair transaction -> receipt
system_streams.deployment: build -> test -> qualify -> staged publish -> outside-in readback -> promote
system_streams.recovery: checkpoint -> failure classification -> alternate carrier -> rehydrate -> verify identity preservation
system_streams.market: capability -> proof -> value metric -> service contract -> frontage -> customer workflow
